import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M

def make_endswith_atoms(natoms, plen, A):
    rules=[]
    random.seed(3)
    toks=[f"s{i}" for i in range(A)]
    for i in range(natoms):
        p=[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(plen)]
        rules.append({'action':'allow','when':{'op':'endswith','path':p}})
    return toks, rules

for A in [2,3,4]:
  for plen in [6,8,10,12]:
    toks,rules=make_endswith_atoms(10,plen,A)
    req={'services':toks,'rules':rules,'queries':[[]]}
    t=time.time()
    try:
        res=M.compile_bundle(req)
        dt=time.time()-t
        print(f"A={A} plen={plen} states={len(res['dfa']['accept'])} time={dt:.3f}")
    except M.WireError as e:
        dt=time.time()-t
        print(f"A={A} plen={plen} ERR={e.code} time={dt:.3f}")
PYEOF
